arxiv-2208-04899.title: Wide binary stars with non-coeval components
arxiv-2208-04899.creator: *, Alexey Kniazev
arxiv-2208-04899.description: Abstract We have estimated masses of components of visual binaries from their spectral classification. We have selected pairs, where the less massive component looks more evolved. Spectral observations of some of such pairs were made, and at least one pair, HD 156331, was confirmed to have components of different age.

arxiv-2210-16587.title: Relating Human Perception of Musicality to Prediction in a Predictive Coding Model
arxiv-2210-16587.creator: Nikolas McNeal 1∗ Jennifer Huang 2∗ Aniekan Umoren 3 Shuqi Dai 2 Roger Dannenberg 2 Richard Randall 2 Tai Sing Lee 2
arxiv-2210-16587.description: Abstract We explore the use of a neural network inspired by predictive coding for modeling human music perception. This network was developed based on the computational neuroscience theory of recurrent interactions in the hierarchical visual cortex. When trained with video data using self-supervised learning, the model manifests behaviors consistent with human visual illusions.

arxiv-2305-05580.title: Fashion CUT: Unsupervised domain adaptation for visual pattern classification in clothes using synthetic data and pseudo-labels
arxiv-2305-05580.creator: Enric Moreu, Alex Martinelli, Martina Naughton, Philip Kelly, Noel E. O’Connor
arxiv-2305-05580.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Enric Moreu, Alex Martinelli, Martina Naughton, Philip Kelly, Noel E. O’Connor. Accurate product information is critical for e-commerce stores to allow customers to browse, filter, and search for products. Product data quality is affected by missing or incorrect information resulting in poor customer experience. While machine learning can be used to correct inaccurate or missing information, achieving high performance on fashion image classification tasks requires large amounts of annotated data, but it is expensive to generate due to labeling costs.

arxiv-2306-04016.title: On seeded subgraph-to-subgraph matching: The ssSGM Algorithm and matchability information theory
arxiv-2306-04016.creator: Lingyao Meng, Mengqi Lou, Jianyu Lin, Vince Lyzinski, Donniell E. Fishkind
arxiv-2306-04016.description: Abstract The subgraph-subgraph matching problem is, given a pair of graphs and a positive integer K K , to find K K vertices in the first graph, K K vertices in the second graph, and a bijection between them, so as to minimize the number of adjacency disagreements across the bijection; it is “seeded” if some of this bijection is

arxiv-2309-00491.title: Feebly-interacting dark matter
arxiv-2309-00491.creator: G. Bélanger, S. Chakraborti, A. Pukhov
arxiv-2309-00491.description: Abstract We briefly review scenarios with feebly interacting particles (FIMPs) as dark matter candidates. The discussion covers issues with dark matter production in the early universe as well as signatures of FIMPs at the high energy and high intensity frontier as well as in astroparticle and cosmology.

arxiv-2404-12348.title: Radio Observations as an Extrasolar Planet Discovery and Characterization: Interior Structure and Habitability
arxiv-2404-12348.creator: T. Joseph W. Lazio
arxiv-2404-12348.description: Abstract Detection of radio emission from Jupiter was identified quickly as being due to its planetary-scale magnetic field. Subsequent spacecraft investigations have revealed that many of the planets, and even some moons, either have or have had large-scale magnetic fields.

arxiv-2409-15685.title: Dual-Comb Photothermal Microscopy
arxiv-2409-15685.creator: Peter Chang ∗ , # \text{Chang}^{*,\#}, Ragib Ishrak ∗ \text{Ishrak}^{*}, Nazanin Hoghooghi, Scott Egbert, Gregory B. Rieker, Scott A. Diddams † \text{Diddams}^{\dagger}, Rohith Reddy
arxiv-2409-15685.description: Abstract * these authors contributed equally # \# peter.chang-1@colorado.edu † \dagger scott.diddams@colorado.edu (Dated: 12 September 2024) We introduce a new parallelized approach to photothermal microscopy that utilizes mid-infrared dual-comb lasers, enabling simultaneous measurements at hundreds of wavelengths. This technology allows for high-speed, label-free chemical identification with super-resolution infrared imaging, overcoming the limitations of slow, single-wavelength-laser methods.

arxiv-2409-16349.title: No Evidence of a Dichotomy in the Elliptical Galaxy Population
arxiv-2409-16349.creator: Rogério Monteiro-Oliveira, Yen-Ting Lin, Wei-Huai Chen, Chen-Yu Chuang, Abdurro’uf, Po-Feng Wu
arxiv-2409-16349.description: Abstract The advent of large integral field spectroscopic surveys has found that elliptical galaxies (EGs) can be classified into two classes: the fast rotators (whose kinematics are dominated by rotation) and the slow rotators (which exhibit slow or no rotation pattern).

arxiv-2411-08132.title: A cat qubit stabilization scheme using a voltage biased Josephson junction
arxiv-2411-08132.creator: T.Aissaoui, A.Murani, R.Lescanne, A.Sarlette
arxiv-2411-08132.description: Abstract DC-voltage-biased Josephson junctions have been recently employed in superconducting circuits for Hamiltonian engineering, demonstrating microwave amplification, single photon sources and entangled photon generation. Compared to more conventional approaches based on parametric pumps, this solution typically enables larger interaction strengths.

arxiv-2505-08549.title: A generalization of Dumas irreducibility criterion
arxiv-2505-08549.creator: Jitender Singh 1,†
arxiv-2505-08549.description: Abstract . Using Newton polygons, a key factorization result for polynomials over discrete valuation domains is proved, which in particular yields new irreducibility criteria including a generalization of the classical irreducibility criterion of Dumas. 2 2 footnotetext: Corresponding author email(s): jitender.math@gndu.ac.in 2020MSC: Primary 12E05; 11C08 Keywords : Dumas irreducibility criterion; Newton polygon; Polynomial factorization; Integer coefficients. 1.

arxiv-2601-17278.title: Evolution of dust in a protoplanetary disc driven by stellar flybys: implications for the streaming instability 2025 Evolution of dust in a protoplanetary disc driven by stellar flybys: implications for the streaming instability – C
arxiv-2601-17278.creator: Wei-Shan Su (蘇唯善), Jeremy L. Smallwood, Min-Kai Lin (林明楷), Chao-Chin Yang (楊朝欽), Nicolás Cuello
arxiv-2601-17278.description: Abstract Stellar flybys are a common dynamical process in young stellar clusters and can significantly reshape protoplanetary discs. However, their impact on dust dynamics remains poorly understood, particularly in the weakly coupled regime (St ≫ \gg 1). We present three-dimensional hydrodynamical simulations of parabolic stellar flybys—both coplanar and inclined—interacting with a gaseous and dusty protoplanetary disc.

arxiv-2601-21257.title: MoCo : A One-Stop Shop for Model Collaboration Research
arxiv-2601-21257.creator: Shangbin Feng, Yuyang Bai, Ziyuan Yang, Yike Wang, Zhaoxuan Tan, Jiajie Yan, Zhenyu Lei, Wenxuan Ding, Weijia Shi, Haojin Wang, Zhenting Qi, Yuru Jiang, Heng Wang, Chengsong Huang, Yu Fei, Jihan Yao, Yilun Du, Luke Zettlemoyer, Yejin Choi, Yulia Tsvetkov
arxiv-2601-21257.description: Abstract Advancing beyond single monolithic language models (LMs), recent research increasingly recognizes the importance of model collaboration , where multiple LMs collaborate, compose, and complement each other. Existing research on this topic has mostly been disparate and disconnected, from different research communities, and lacks rigorous comparison.

arxiv-2605-23844.title: Minor Merger, Major Growth: An Overmassive, Highly Accreting Black Hole Powering a Secondary AGN In a Cosmic Noon Minor Merger
arxiv-2605-23844.creator: Marko Mićić

britannica-1911-flint-stone.title: Flint (stone) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-flint-stone.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-flint-stone.description: Article 'Flint (stone)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. elevated conical mark, is produced. This serves to distinguish flints which have been fashioned by human agencies from those which have been split merely by the action of frost and the weather. The bulb is evidence of a direct blow, probably intentionally made, and is a point of some importance to archaeologists investigating Palaeolithic implements.

pmc-10504047.title: Clinical Application of Inferior Alveolar Nerve Block Device for Safe and Secure IANB by Any Operator
pmc-10504047.creator: Tomoyasu Noguchi, Kento Odaka, Ken-ichi Fukuda
pmc-10504047.description: The inferior alveolar nerve block (IANB) is an established technique with a success rate of 60–80%; however, large errors have been reported among operators. Some dentists do not prefer to use IANB because of the risk of complications. Nevertheless, it is a useful technique for pain control, and a secure IANB offers significant benefits to operators and patients.

pmc-10695992.title: KIAA1429 facilitates progression of hepatocellular carcinoma by modulating m6A levels in HPN
pmc-10695992.creator: Yu Meng, Wenwen Yang, Jinchao Li, Wei Chai
pmc-10695992.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundMost N6-methyladenosine (m6A)-associated modulatory proteins are involved in the pathogenesis of various cancers. The roles of m6A-related genes in liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) and the associated mechanisms remain unknown.MethodsGEO and GEPIA2 databases were used to identify the m6A modification-related genes which were differentially expressed in LIHC and adjacent non-tumor tissues, and quantitative PCR was used to evaluate the expression of KIAA1429, a major m6A methyltransferase, in LIHC cells.

pmc-10735867.title: RECIPROCAL RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN SENSE OF PURPOSE AND COGNITIVE CHANGE IN OLDER ADULTHOOD: A COORDINATED ANALYSIS
pmc-10735867.creator: Gabrielle Pfund, Bryan James, Patrick Hill, Jason Hassenstab, Payton Rule, Emily Willroth
pmc-10735867.description: Sense of purpose (i.e., the extent to which one has personally meaningful goals and directions guiding them through life) is a consistent promoter of healthy aging for older adults. Unfortunately, while individuals benefit from having a high sense of purpose as they age, many people’s sense of purpose declines during older adulthood.

pmc-11406784.title: Therapeutic efficacy of artemether–lumefantrine in the treatment of uncomplicated Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Arba Minch Zuria District, Gamo Zone, Southwest Ethiopia
pmc-11406784.creator: Demeke Daka, Daniel Woldeyes, Lemu Golassa, Gezahegn Solomon Alemayehu, Zerihun Zewde, Girum Tamiru, Tadesse Misganaw, Fekadu Massebo, Biniam Wondale
pmc-11406784.description: BackgroundArtemether–lumefantrine (AL) has been the primary anti-malarial drug used to treat uncomplicated Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Ethiopia since 2004. However, there have been recent reports of AL resistance mutations in different African countries, including Ethiopia. This is concerning and requires periodic monitoring of anti-malarial drug resistance.

pmc-11455357.title: 7824 Orbital Lymphoma masquerading as Thyroid Eye Disease
pmc-11455357.creator: S Ganawa, S Joseph, C Anshuman, D Luciane L, A Sajid, C Anne, S Dhage
pmc-11455357.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Dhage: None.Thyroid eye disease (TED) is the most common extrathyroidal manifestation in Graves’ disease (GD). In this case report, we present a case of a 64 years old lady, who was initially diagnosed with thyroid eye disease about 9 years ago. However, she was clinically and biochemically euthyroid. She was offered an orbital decompression surgery by local ophthalmology team.

pmc-11507209.title: Candidemia in Pediatric-Clinic: Frequency of Occurrence, Candida Species, Antifungal Susceptibilities, and Effects on Mortality (2020–2024)
pmc-11507209.creator: Kamuran Şanlı, Esra Arslantaş, Ayşe Nur Ceylan, Beyza Öncel, Duygu Özkorucu, Ayşe Özkan Karagenç, Mario Cruciani, Alessandro Russo
pmc-11507209.description: Objective: Invasive candidiasis is defined as an important infection that increases the duration of patients’ hospital stay, costs, mortality and morbidity. In this study, we aimed to investigate the frequency of candidiasis in blood cultures of pediatric hematology patients, Candida species, antifungal susceptibilities, and their effects on mortality.

pmc-11608241.title: Abnormal events detection using spatio-temporal saliency descriptor and fuzzy representation analysis
pmc-11608241.creator: R Tino Merlin, R Karthick, A Aalan Babu, G Vennira Selvi, D Usha, R Nithya
pmc-11608241.description: In recent years, the research on abnormal events detection is a significant work in surveillance video. Many researchers have been attracted by this work for the past two decades. As a result, several abnormal event detection approaches have been developed. Though several approaches have been used in the field still many problems remain to get the abnormal events detection accuracy.

pmc-12499387.title: Defect‐Driven Reconstruction of Bismuth Nanoflowers via Precursor Engineering for Highly Efficient CO2‐to‐Formate Electrochemical Reduction
pmc-12499387.creator: Jiaying Yan, Masao Kamiko, Teruyasu Mizoguchi, Shunsuke Yagi
pmc-12499387.description: Electrochemical reduction of CO2 represents a promising strategy for converting CO2 into value‐added chemical products. Currently, significant efforts have been devoted to developing more efficient Bi‐based catalysts to reduce CO2 to formate. However, the role of precursor defects in directing the electrochemical reconstruction of Bi‐based catalysts is yet to be thoroughly investigated.

pmc-13199532.title: Radiotherapy strategies for nonagenarian cancer patients at a tertiary cancer center
pmc-13199532.creator: Kae Okuma, Ayaka Nagao, Koji Inaba, Tairo Kashihara, Kana Takahashi, Madoka Sakuramachi, Akane Yoshiba, Akikazu Kobori, Shoki Nakamura, Hiroshi Igaki
pmc-13199532.description: PurposeWith increasing life expectancy, the clinical role of radiotherapy in cancer patients aged ≥ 90 years warrants systematic evaluation. This study aimed to assess treatment patterns, safety, and outcomes of radiotherapy in the super-elderly at a tertiary cancer center.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 119 patients aged ≥ 90 years who underwent radiotherapy between 2007 and 2025.

pmc-13217948.title: The association of the composite dietary antioxidant index with the risk of cardiometabolic disorders: findings from the Tehran Lipid and Glucose Study
pmc-13217948.creator: Hamid Ahmadirad, Hossein Farhadnejad, Niloufar Saber, Mitra Kazemi Jahromi, Farshad Teymoori, Parvin Mirmiran, Fereidoun Azizi
pmc-13217948.description: Background/ObjectiveDietary antioxidants have been suggested to play a protective role against chronic diseases. This prospective study aimed to examine the association between the composite dietary antioxidant index (CDAI) and the risk of type 2 diabetes (T2D), hypertension, and abdominal obesity.

pmc-13311826.creator: Lisa Büttgen, Malou van der Sluis, Stina Auerbach, Anne Collin, Abel B. Ekiri, Klaus Wimmers, Tiago Fernandes Farias, Hannes Bergmann, Esther D. Ellen

pmc-13323302.creator: Ya-fei Cheng, Cong-li Meng, Yi-ru Wang, Lin Chen, Ya-qun Ma, Wen-zhi Guo, Hang Guo

pmc-13391501.title: Metabolic characterization of the tumor microenvironment orchestrates therapeutic strategies and clinical outcomes in pancreatic cancer
pmc-13391501.creator: Rong Tang, Yangyi Li, Cong Zhou, Chunbin Zhu, Chen Chen, Liquan Jin, Yueyue Chen, Yingna Liao, Yuan Liu, Qiong Du, Yubin Lei, Zijian Wu, Jin Xu, Wei Wang, Xiaoyu Yin, Chenghao Shao, Si Shi, Xianjun Yu
pmc-13391501.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Metabolic reprogramming and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) are hallmark features driving pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) progression. Despite the therapeutic potential of targeting immunometabolism, effective strategies remain scarce in clinical practice, likely due to cell-specific metabolic heterogeneity within PDAC TME. Here, we show integration of three algorithms to estimate metabolic fluxomes and pathways using scRNA-seq data, generating a comprehensive cell type-specific metabolic atlas.

pmc-13582316.title: Live auxotrophic vaccines contribute to protection against chronic lung infections caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa in C57BL/6 mice
pmc-13582316.creator: Víctor Fuentes-Valverde, Alexandra Correia, Patricia García, Elena Pérez-Antón, Irina Amorim, Soraya Rumbo-Feal, Maria P. Cabral, Manuel Vilanova, Miriam Moscoso, Germán Bou
pmc-13582316.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pseudomonas aeruginosa causes severe, often multidrug-resistant lung infections, especially in individuals with cystic fibrosis, highlighting vaccination as a promising preventive approach. This study evaluated intranasal and intradermal immunization with a D-glutamate auxotrophic P. aeruginosa strain (PAO1 ΔmurI) and two of its derivatives, one with additional D-alanine auxotrophy and another exhibiting reduced lipopolysaccharide-associated toxicity, in C57BL/6 mice using both acute and chronic lung infection models. Mice received two or three doses at various intervals, and safety was assessed through clinical and weight monitoring.
